facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 52°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 29.

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations between 12 days earlier and 1 day later this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Lyman Lake
evidence.detail: left June 13; earlier seasons: June 11 (2023), June 25 (2024), June 12 (2025)

evidence.name: Trinity
evidence.detail: left May 1; earlier seasons: May 13 (2023), May 8 (2024), May 7 (2025)

evidence.name: Park Creek Ridge

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the second highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Lyman Lake (5,990 ft) and the lowest at Trinity (2,890 ft) and Park Creek Ridge (4,610 ft).

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 16 and July 15, carried from the melt-out dates at Lyman Lake (5,990 ft) and Park Creek Ridge (4,610 ft) to the pass elevation.
